Example Corp

Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.

On September 15, 2026, Example Corp (the "Company") entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") pursuant to which the Company will acquire Target Software Inc. ("Target") in a transaction valued at approximately $4.2 billion. Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, each outstanding share of Target common stock will be converted into the right to receive $38.50 per share, consisting of 60% in cash and 40% in shares of the Company's common stock. The Company expects to issue approximately 21 million shares of its common stock in the transaction and to fund the cash portion with a new $1.8 billion senior notes offering and a $1.0 billion term loan. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to Target stockholder approval and regulatory clearances.
